text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Now then, the wind is southeasterly. The sky carries the scent of rain.
Surrendering oneself to drift upon the wind is fine as well.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Or maybe
we should try leaving trail markers for once as we go."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Some time had passed since I began accompanying Mr. C.B. on her walks.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Without asking where she was going, I simply followed along.
That was all, but I still learned so much about her.
For example—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If I remember right, I feel like there was a zoo further down this road.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even if Mr. C.B. decided to "head for the zoo"—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I'll take a leisurely stroll down the tree-lined path.
And grab a drink along the way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She almost never manages to make it to the zoo.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Wah, found it!
It's the line between rain and clear skies.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
How incredible... The rain is sparkling in the sunlight.
It looks like jewels falling from the sky.
choice_data_list: Mr. C.B.... what about the zoo?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...A zoo?
Ah, did I say something like that?"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B. cannot make plans.
Or rather, she cannot carry them out.
...She probably doesn't have much desire to, either. On top of that—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Nyaa~. Aren't you a cutie?
Do you know what town this is?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, you don't know either, huh. ...I don't
even have a smartphone, so this is quite a pickle.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wandering aimlessly with empty hands,
immediately getting lost.

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text: A dine-and-dasher! Seize them!!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hm, that person?

text_block_list.name: Ramen Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, if you catch it,
I'll treat you to a meal!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, nice.
I was just getting hungry!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Getting caught up in trouble.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Hey, isn't there someone over there?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That man over there...
He's singing something... It's so soothing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Encountering strange things, and so on.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Compared to twilight, the morning glow looks so much clearer, doesn't it? I wonder why that is.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that was amazing.
Watching the egg crack open little by little...

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, newborn birds are so adorable.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sometimes I wouldn't get home until dawn.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A time far more carefree and unrestrained than imagined.
Naturally, it was in direct violation of the school regulations.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If not for the promise of strict non-interference,
there's no telling how many times I would have stopped them.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Strangely enough, I didn't find it painful at all.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And then one day, while walking her home in the evening, I ran into someone unexpected.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, CB.
Welcome back. Dinner is just about ready.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Mom, Dad!
You came.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right right.
This here's my Trainer.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Oh, so you're the Trainer?
Thank you for taking such good care of my girl.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text: I've been wanting to see you, but we always seem to just miss each other.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
My family home's pretty close by. They drop by to check on me
every now and then. You know, seeing as I'm like this and all.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Basically, I want to give her freedom.
But I still worry sometimes.
Just for a little while longer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really are a worrywart, aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that reminds me!
Trainer, you should stay and eat too!
Everything we make here is absolutely delicious.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, we decided to have dinner together.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, Trainer, it seems like you've been taking walks with me quite a lot lately!

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text: It must be tough. We go along with them from time to time too, but... they truly are wild, to say the least.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "True enough, for better or worse, she walked wherever she pleased, giving me more than a few scares along the way."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When I nodded solemnly, perhaps it gave them the wrong idea...
because my parents leaned forward in a panic.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
“Still... but Trainer!
There are good parts to it too!”

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Exactly, I don't walk on paved roads.
That is precisely why an unknown world unfolds before me.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Her parents' words sounded familiar.
The boundary line in the rain, a hatching chick,
the poet of the sea, the dine-and-dasher..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: These were all things I never could have seen during those days spent doing nothing but going back and forth between the Trainer's office and the track.
choice_data_list: ("An unknown world is opening up," huh...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, the reason I scouted Mr. C.B.
was that I fell in love with her utterly free—
and unorthodox running style.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ignoring win rates and running straight from the heart.
And yet, she still wins.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She makes you believe she can do anything.
She has the power to bring color to a faded world. So—
choice_data_list: Her free-spiritedness is a wonderful thing

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?
choice_data_list: As a Trainer, I'm certain of it

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Mother
text_block_list.text:
Is that so...!
I'm glad you feel that way. What a relief...

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
I understand now why CB chose you.
Please continue to take good care of her.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...
...Ahaha. Geez, what's with you?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: …………Look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days later, it happened while the two of us were walking along the riverbank after sunset.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
There was a time when you tried
to understand what I see in races, wasn't there?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall, it was before scouting her.
Wanting to see things from the same perspective as someone who loved racing more than anything, I once made a proposal.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Huh, want to give it one more try?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just an abstract idea didn't get the point across.
So I came up with an alternative plan.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: If I let you ride on my back while I run—
choice_data_list: No good, you're in too much danger.
No, it's too dangerous for you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"It's fine, it's fine. I won't go top speed.
And the distance is just a tiny bit."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Please.
You don't even have to understand, just—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I really want you to see that view too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Mr. C.B.'s resolve was firm...
In the end, I was smoothly talked into it, and before I knew it, I was riding on her back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
All right, here we go.
Hold on tight, okay?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She bounced lightly on her toes,
then began to jog slowly. After running like that
for a while, her body suddenly sank low—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Tah!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Burst out all at once.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The scenery flies past us one after another. The wind whips fiercely past my ears.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her shoulders heave rhythmically.
Mr. C.B.'s heartbeat resonates.
Her light breathing can be heard.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha, well? Isn't it amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her bubbly voice melted into the dim twilight,
drifting away in the blink of an eye—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At speeds impossible for human legs to reach,
over distances impossible for human stamina to cover,
she ran on and on into the distance.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Haa, hah..., phew...
Running with someone really is different from running alone.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
“Still, that was interesting. So much fun.
...How about you?”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Running on the turf with your own legs,
and being carried along the riverbank by someone else...
Frankly, they're quite different, aren't they?
choice_data_list: I can't quite say I understand. But—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Speed rising in buoyant bursts.
The surrounding scenery blurring until it can no longer be tracked.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With every rise in speed, the exhilaration mounts,
compelling me to gaze ahead, yearning for more and more.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was without a doubt the closest a human could ever come
to experiencing the world through the eyes of an Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If she weren't so unconventional, if she weren't the kind of Umamusume who refuses to listen even when stopped,
I surely would never have experienced something like this.
choice_data_list: Thank you for showing me such a wonderful view.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. I see.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I believed in you; I knew you'd understand.
